insights.summary: The agent performed a systematic exploration and implemented several Python-level micro-optimizations in the core execution path. While the changes were logically sound and followed a clear plan, the agent failed to implement the specific tensor-level optimizations requested and hit the turn limit before finalizing the task according to the specific git/finish instructions.
strengths: Methodical planning and use of Todo list
Strong understanding of Python performance overheads (attribute lookups)
Good recovery from file-not-found errors during exploration
weaknesses: Failed to produce a working timing benchmark
Turn management: spent too much time on minor edits and hit the turn limit
